channel.title: Mali - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Mali, every source cited.

item.title: Mali meteorite yields early findings
item.description: A space rock found in the Sahara desert in 2022 has revealed its first scientific results.

item.title: Mali's ISPRIC signs first deal with Russian university
item.description: The Malian institute will offer joint engineering programs and double degrees with Russia's Kalashnikov State Technical University.

item.title: Mali targets first medal at Dakar Youth Olympics
item.description: Five Malian athletes aged 15-17 will compete in athletics, fencing, judo, swimming, and taekwondo.

item.title: Malians buy street drugs amid high pharmacy costs
item.description: Doctors warn of poisoning and treatment failure from unregulated medicines sold without prescriptions.

item.title: Malian artist Pakenzy blends genres to reach young audiences
item.description: Rapper Moriba Coulibaly, known as Pakenzy, mixes hip-hop, afrobeat, and R&B influences to create accessible music.
